fichas.title: Escalators for Shops, Offices, and Transport Facilities
fichas.summary: Escalators provide continuous transport for large numbers of people and are not treated as stairs for building-regulation purposes. The page covers planning openings and pits, step widths, capacities, speeds, slopes, circulation arrangements, and safety requirements. A 35° pitch is more space-efficient, while 30° is required for travel heights of at least 6 m; 27–28° is recommended where possible in transport facilities. Provide queuing space at both ends.
uses: Continuous movement of people between levels
Passenger circulation in department stores, offices, administration buildings, trade fair halls, airports, underground railway stations, and public transport facilities
